control_flow: driveInTheDark: if RLIGHT reads more than 75 %, drive forward at 30 %; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line; inside a dark tunnel with no line, drive straight through without touching its walls; follow the line again after the tunnel.

decision_points.condition: the right light sensor reads more than 75 % (bright light from above)

branches.outcome: bright: it drives forward at 30 % and doesn't steer by the line

decision_points.condition: an obstacle is ahead (front obstacle sensor)

branches.outcome: an obstacle is ahead: it stops

scenarios.coded_response: In bright light it drives straight forward at 30 % and never steers by the line.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on a black line, facing along it, in bright light in the open.
scenarios.trigger: The line bends or runs on ahead.
scenarios.title: Follows the line in bright light
assumptions: The end of the line is where it should get to.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the black line, also where it bends, to its end.

scenarios.coded_response: In dim light, with no obstacle and no black line, it curves right (left wheel 40 %, right 10 %).
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is in a straight tunnel, in dim light, facing along it, with no line on the floor and nothing in front of it.
scenarios.trigger: The robot is inside the tunnel in the dark.
scenarios.title: Drives straight through a dark tunnel
assumptions: The tunnel is straight and wide enough for the robot.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It drives straight through the tunnel to its far end without touching the walls.

scenarios.coded_response: It stops while the wall is ahead.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is in a straight tunnel, in dim light, with a wall across the tunnel ahead of it.
scenarios.trigger: The front obstacle sensor sees the wall.
scenarios.title: Stops at a wall across the dark tunnel
assumptions: You didn't say what should happen when a wall blocks the tunnel, but driving into it would be bad.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It stops before the wall without bumping into it.

scenarios.coded_response: On black it curves left (left wheel 10 %, right 40 %); on the floor it curves right (left wheel 40 %, right 10 %).
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is in a dark tunnel, on a black line that runs along the tunnel, facing along the line.
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker sees black, then the floor, again and again.
scenarios.title: Follows the line in a dark tunnel
assumptions: You said the tunnel has no line; this takes a tunnel where the line runs on, so the robot should follow it.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line through the tunnel to its far end.

uncertainties: In bright light your program drives straight and never steers by the line, although you said it should follow it.
In the dark with no line your program curves right, so it turns towards the tunnel's wall instead of driving straight.
Your program follows a line only in dim light inside a tunnel, when the line tracker sees black; that is the only way it ever curves left on black.
You didn't say what the robot should do when a wall blocks the tunnel in the dark.
The obstacle sensors look forward, so the tunnel's own walls are not seen while the robot faces along the tunnel.
